scopePolicy.name: CONTINUITY_PRESERVING_CURRENT_SCOPE_V2
includeRules: Include every formally accepted route from Accepted193.
Include every Historical262 route that remains live in Current Official evidence and is not already accepted.
excludeRules: Exclude Historical262 routes that are no longer live in Current Official evidence and were never formally accepted.
Exclude Current Official routes discovered only in the later raw 817-route sitemap unless separately admitted through explicit scope-expansion change control.
scopePolicy.reason: Preserves all formally accepted work and all still-live members of the original project scope without promoting raw sitemap growth to project scope.

humanVisualPolicy: Present outliers/ambiguous cases; never record VISUAL_OK when evidence was not presented.
